user.title: Power Fingerprint
user.description: Pick the sensor that measures the whole panel, then the per-circuit power sensors.

data.confidence: How sure do you want to be?

data_description.mains: The sensor reading the whole panel. Its total should be close to the sum of the circuits below.
data_description.circuits: One sensor per breaker. Leave out phase and total sensors, or they will be counted twice.
data_description.price_per_kwh: Used only to turn standby watts into an annual figure. Pre-filled from your energy dashboard's configured price when it has one, so there is only one place to keep it right.
data_description.coverage_tolerance_pct: How far the circuits may drift from the mains before a fault is raised. 5% is comfortably outside normal noise.
data_description.contradiction_pairs: One `switch.entity: sensor.circuit_power` per line. Each pair is checked for a switch that says on while its circuit draws nothing.
data_description.confidence: Cautious answers only where the evidence clearly beats coincidence. Eager finds more and gets some of them wrong in a way you cannot see. A missing answer is visible; a wrong one looks exactly like a right one.

error.mains_missing: {entity} does not exist. Pick a sensor that is currently loaded.
error.mains_not_numeric: {entity} is not reporting a number right now, so it cannot be used as the mains reading.
error.circuit_missing: Circuit sensor {entity} does not exist. Pick sensors that are currently loaded.

learn.name: Learn fingerprints
learn.description: Read history for each circuit, group the appliance runs it finds by shape, and store them as candidates.

threshold.name: Cluster threshold
threshold.description: Lower splits more. Leave empty to use the confidence setting's threshold.

label.name: Name a fingerprint
label.description: Turn a candidate into an identification.

circuit.name: Circuit
circuit.description: The power sensor it was learned on.

verify_circuit.name: Verify a circuit by switching a device
verify_circuit.description: Switch a device and watch which circuit moves. Actuates the device; only switches and lights may be probed, and the prior state is always restored.

probes.name: Number of probes
probes.description: All probes must agree. Leave empty to use the confidence setting.

settle.name: Settle time
settle.description: Seconds to wait for the meter after each switch, at least twice its reporting interval.

pause_automations.name: Pause interfering automations
pause_automations.description: Temporarily switch off automations that could move this device mid-probe. Safety-related automations are never paused.

force.name: Probe anyway
force.description: Switch the device even though it is currently carrying a load. Only set this when you know nothing is running on it.

map_devices.name: Map devices to circuits
map_devices.description: Work out which circuit each self-metering device sits on, by correlating each device's own power reading against every circuit. Reports what it could not place as well as what it could.

step.name: Grid seconds
step.description: Leave empty to measure your meter's reporting interval from its own history.

min_correlation.name: Minimum correlation
min_correlation.description: Lower places more devices and places more of them wrongly. Leave empty to use the confidence setting.

autolabel.name: Name the obvious ones
autolabel.description: Name every learned shape whose circuit already says what it is - a circuit titled 'Dish Washer' with a single recurring shape. Circuits with several shapes, or with no appliance name, are listed for you rather than guessed at.

apply_circuit_labels.name: Label devices with their circuit
apply_circuit_labels.description: Add a label naming the circuit each mapped device sits on, so you can filter by breaker anywhere in Home Assistant. Defaults to a dry run - it shows what it would do and changes nothing until you say otherwise.

dry_run.name: Dry run
dry_run.description: Show what would happen without changing anything. On by default.

remove.name: Remove instead
remove.description: Take the circuit labels back off every device.

prefix.name: Label prefix
prefix.description: What each label is called before the circuit's name.

not_loaded.message: Power Fingerprint is not loaded, so this action cannot run. Check the integration on the Devices & services page.

unknown_fingerprint.message: There is no fingerprint named {label} on {circuit}. Run the learn action first, then name one of the candidates it returns.

device_unavailable.message: {device} is not available right now, so switching it would prove nothing.

battery_powered.message: {device} is battery powered. It draws no mains current, so no circuit can show it switching and there is nothing to measure.

carrying_load.message: {device} will not be probed: {reason}. Pass force: true only if you are certain nothing on it matters.

no_history.message: The recorder returned no history for any of the {count} circuits, so nothing could be compared. This is an unread result, not an absence of matches.

recorder_not_running.message: The recorder is not running, so there is no history to read. Enable the recorder integration and try again.

sources_missing.message: Waiting for {count} power sensor(s) to appear, starting with {entity}.

automation_service_missing.message: automation.turn_on is not registered yet and {count} automation(s) paused for a probe still need restoring.

bad_unit.title: A configured sensor is not reporting power
bad_unit.description: {entity} reports in {unit}, which is not a power unit, so it has been excluded from every total. Every figure in Power Fingerprint is in watts. Either correct the sensor's unit, or remove it from the circuit list in the integration options.

options.cautious: Cautious - fewer answers, trust all of them
options.eager: Eager - more answers, some wrong (exploring a panel)
